title: Caching and Utilities
summary: This module provides caching mechanisms for language model interactions and utility functions for managing cache behavior and LiteLLM logging.

nodes.label: Configure Cache
nodes.title: Configure Cache Settings
nodes.description: Initializes and configures the DSPy caching system, allowing control over disk and memory caching, directory, size limits, and pickle serialization restrictions.

nodes.label: Get DSPy Cache Instance
nodes.title: Retrieve DSPy Cache
nodes.description: Retrieves or initializes the DSPy cache instance, falling back to a memory-only cache if disk cache setup fails.

nodes.label: Synchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Synchronous Caching
nodes.description: A decorator or utility function that wraps synchronous function calls, caching their results based on input arguments and returning cached results when available.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Caching
nodes.description: A decorator or utility function that wraps asynchronous function calls, caching their results and returning cached results for subsequent identical calls.

nodes.label: Restricted Disk Serialization
nodes.title: Secure Disk Serialization
nodes.description: A specialized disk serialization class that restricts pickle deserialization to an allowlist of safe types, enhancing security.

nodes.label: Cached Compute Embeddings
nodes.title: Cached Embedding Computation
nodes.description: A utility function that computes embeddings, leveraging the caching mechanism to store and retrieve previously computed embeddings for efficiency.

nodes.label: Cached Async Compute Embeddings
nodes.title: Cached Asynchronous Embedding Computation
nodes.description: An asynchronous utility function that computes embeddings, utilizing the caching system to avoid redundant computations.

nodes.label: Enable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Activate LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.description: Enables detailed debug logging for LiteLLM, providing insights into API interactions and responses.

nodes.label: Disable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Deactivate LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.description: Disables detailed debug logging for LiteLLM, reducing log verbosity to error messages only.

nodes.label: Base LM Clients
nodes.title: Base Language Model Clients
nodes.description: Provides foundational interfaces and implementations for interacting with various language models, including local and cloud-based providers.

nodes.label: LM API Interaction
nodes.title: Language Model API Interaction
nodes.description: Handles the core logic for interacting with language model APIs, including completion, streaming, and request formatting.

groups.label: Cache Management
groups.title: Cache Management
groups.description: Functions and components responsible for configuring, initializing, and interacting with the DSPy caching system.

groups.label: Caching Wrappers
groups.title: Caching Wrappers
groups.description: Decorators and utilities that apply caching logic to synchronous and asynchronous function calls.

groups.label: Embedding Caching
groups.title: Embedding Caching
groups.description: Specialized functions for caching the computation of embeddings to improve performance.

groups.label: Logging Control
groups.title: LiteLLM Logging Control
groups.description: Utilities for enabling and disabling detailed logging for the LiteLLM integration.
